# Score relevance with canonical breakdown, version field, configurable selection, and chunked articleRelevances POST

**Group:** Article Analysis Agent (`article-analysis-agent`)

## Summary

Computes per-article `score` in zero to one inclusive with a non-empty `scoreBreakdown` map. Uses PRD canonical v1 keys `breakingNews`, `kgRelation`, `fundamental`, `tickerSalience`, and `sourceQuality`, allows additional experimental numeric keys, and includes `_version` as an integer matching configurable `ARTICLE_ANALYSIS_SCORE_BREAKDOWN_VERSION` (MP-ART-ANALYSIS-009). Applies documented selection rules so `selected` reflects configurable thresholds and caps for downstream pipelines. POSTs `articleRelevances` in validated chunks per FR9.

## Scope

- In scope: Heuristic and or LLM-assisted relevance aligned with product priority dimensions breaking news, KG relation changes, and fundamentals as breakdown components (FR5). Selection logic configurable (threshold, max selected per ticker per day, optional diversity or intent mix caps as in PRD Hermes section). Chunked POST with schema validation. Align PRD breakdown semantics with observability canonical keys.
- Out of scope: Admin UI for tuning (use env or Hermes config). Optional `dedupOrOverlap` penalty can be stubbed or implemented if time permits.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Every relevance row has `score` in zero to one and non-empty `scoreBreakdown`.
- [ ] `scoreBreakdown` includes `_version` integer and all five canonical v1 keys as numeric components for core charts (additional keys optional).
- [x] Final `score` is consistent with documented weighting from configured weights map (MP-ART-ANALYSIS-009).
- [x] `selected` follows documented rules (for example top-K per ticker per day and minimum score) and is configurable without code deploy for routine tuning.
- [ ] POST responses `articlesScored` and `articlesSelected` match persisted outcome or errors are raised.
- [x] Chunked POSTs comply with FR9 and FR6.
- [ ] Unit tests cover breakdown shape, version field, selection edge cases, and validation failures.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: MP-ART-ANALYSIS-005
- Blocks: MP-ART-ANALYSIS-007

## Notes

Update [analysis.mdx](dev-docs/docs/mediapulse/apps/agents/analysis.mdx) and [knowledge-graph.mdx](dev-docs/docs/mediapulse/knowledge-graph/knowledge-graph.mdx) to replace legacy breakdown names (`aliasMatch`, `entityOverlap`, etc.) with canonical keys, either in this ticket or MP-ART-ANALYSIS-009 per team split. Product order breaking news, KG relation, fundamentals should appear explicitly in docs.

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/article-analysis-agent-prd.md
